in_hebrew.name: Tobrian
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is good
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tobrian הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Tobit in the Old Testament, Tobrian means 'God is good'. Tobit, a righteous man, was blessed by God with a wife and son after a long and difficult life. This name is a reminder of the goodness and faithfulness of God.

in_greek.name: Tobrian
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is good
in_greek.long_meaning: Tobrian είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Tobit in the Old Testament, Tobrian means 'God is good'. Tobit, a righteous man, was blessed by God with a wife and son after a long and difficult life. This name is a reminder of the goodness and faithfulness of God.

in_latin.name: Tobrianus
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum de origine Hebraica, derivatum a Tobias
in_latin.long_meaning: Tobrianus, nomen Christianum, derivatum a Tobias, nomine prophetae, qui apparuit in libro apocrypho de Tobias. Nomen hoc in ecclesia Christi aeterna usitatum est, sed non est ibi in scripturis sacris. Tamen, nomen Tobiani significat 'Deus mihi est auxilium', quod est gratum nomen in ecclesia Christiana, quae auxilium ab omnipotente Deo quaerit.
